hananils.structure-accordion.batch.info: Select fields you would like to overwrite. Keep those unselected you don't want to change.
hananils.structure-accordion.batch.place: Placeholders are used to reference existing content from the current field, the item, its position or index.
{{ item }} allows you to cross-reference sibling field content.
{{ field }} gives you access to the current field and the fields methods. You can use {{ field.value }} to reference the current value.
{{ index }} provides you with the index of the current item in relation to the selection, starting at zero.
{{ position }} provides you with the position of the current item in relation to the selection, starting at one.
